title: Rappler Live Jam: ALAMAT
summary: ALAMAT returns to the Rappler HQ to perform songs from their sophomore album 'DESTINO'!

blocks.text: ALAMAT returns to the Rappler HQ to perform songs from their sophomore album 'DESTINO'!
Editor’s Note: This episode is sponsored by Hanabishi
MANILA, Philippines – ALAMAT returns to Rappler Live Jam on Saturday, November 28!

Composed of Alas, Taneo, R-Ji, Mo, Jao, and Tomas, the six-member P-pop group debuted with the single “kbye” in 2021, and released its first EP Pasulong in 2022. The sextet then dropped its first full-length album IsaPuso in 2023.
ALAMAT’s latest record is DESTINO — fronted by songs like “Sinigang,” “Hiraya,” “Sa ‘Yo Pa Rin Uuwi,” and the fan-favorite “Luzviminda.”
Catch ALAMAT on Rappler Live Jam on Saturday, 8 pm, by bookmarking this page or heading to Rappler’s YouTube! – Rappler.com
